title: Swe senior scenario schema migration live
topic: Swe senior scenario schema migration live
question: You need to rename a column that's actively read and written by a high-traffic production service, with zero downtime and no window for a maintenance freeze. How do you sequence the migration?
idealAnswer:
Recognizes the core constraint: because of the rolling deploy, old code (using the old column name) and new code (using the new name) will run simultaneously for a period, so a single-step rename would break one version or the other

Proposes a multi-step, backward-compatible migration: add the new column first, dual-write to both old and new columns, backfill existing rows, switch reads over to the new column, then stop writing to the old column, then drop it, each step deployed and verified separately

Explicitly sequences deploys around the data migration, not just the schema change, e.g. dual-write code has to be live before the backfill runs, and reads shouldn't switch to the new column until the backfill is confirmed complete

Addresses rollback safety at each step, a strong answer picks an order where any individual step can be reverted without data loss or breaking currently-running instances

Mentions verifying data consistency between old and new columns before cutting over reads (e.g. a comparison/audit query), rather than assuming the backfill and dual-write are correct
